title: 第 5 章 首个强制任务夺回灵泉机缘第 6 章 隐忍布局静待天命破绽
lines: 系统急促的警示音在脑海里炸响，陆衍猛地站起身，心头一紧。
原本定在深夜的灵泉灵气真空窗口期，被天道硬生生提前数个时辰，留给自己的行动时间骤然被压缩，错过这次就要再等七天，七天之后苏辰靠着灵泉海量灵气修为突飞猛进，气运层层叠加，自己触发强制任务失败，下场便是丹田碎裂、当场身死。
一旁的赵小胖被陆衍突如其来的动作吓了一跳，挠着胖乎乎的脸蛋疑惑发问：“少爷咋了？出啥事了？难不成苏辰明天登门的计划变卦了？”
陆衍摇了摇头，没时间和小胖细细解释天道暗中改规则的猫腻，快速叮嘱：“小胖你留在宅院待命，替我盯紧陆家大门，若是苏辰提前派人打探行踪，第一时间传信，周伯继续留守库房看管丹药，严防对方提前暗中打探资源。”
安排完两人的任务，陆衍迅速换上一身深色紧身夜行衣，腰间只系一把用来开路的短匕，不带任何随从。带人潜入容易被天道借题发挥，扣上聚众寻衅的罪名，孤身行动才契合良心底线的行动准则，能最大化触发系统良心奖励。
出门前，陆衍调出系统任务面板再看一遍：
【主线强制任务：三日内夺回陆家祖传先天灵，剩余时限：最后一日】
【任务成功：良心暴击评级随机发放修为、功法、气运；任务失败：丹田破碎，修为清零，即刻抹杀】
全宗门如今舆论早已被天道篡改，上到宗门长老，下到普通外门弟子，所有人都认定灵泉归苏辰是天命所归，陆家想要拿回灵泉就是无理取闹，但凡陆衍带着陆家护卫浩浩荡荡上门，不等靠近灵谷，就会被提前埋伏的苏辰跟班围堵，苏辰顺势卖惨博取同情，海量气运入账，自己反倒满盘皆输。
摒弃原主无脑硬闯的蠢办法，陆衍绕开宗门主路，专挑偏僻山林小路赶路。天道残存的厄运deb依旧在暗中作祟，路边荆棘莫名疯长缠在裤脚，头顶枯枝无风坠落，时不时还有碎石从山壁滚落，处处都是天道刻意制造的小阻碍。
好在之前数次行善积攒的功德持续抵消负面效果，大部分意外都被轻松化解，陆衍一路磕磕绊绊，避开灵谷布满陷阱的正门，朝着此前打探到的后山悬崖位置潜行。
半个时辰后，陆衍抵达后山崖底。眼前崖壁陡峭，怪石嶙峋，岩壁上零星生长着攀岩藤蔓，也难怪苏辰压根没在此处布置陷阱，在他眼里这处险地普通人根本没法顺利登顶。
陆衍炼气三层的修为，肉身经过数次功德小幅淬炼，远超同阶修士，抓着粗壮藤蔓稳步向上攀爬，半个时辰顺利登上灵谷后山内部。
躲在茂密参天古树的树冠里，陆静静俯瞰整片灵泉山谷。此刻天色擦黑，灵泉泉眼之上白雾缭绕，源源不断的精纯灵气四散飘逸，苏辰并不在谷中，白天闭关结束后便带着几名心腹弟子下山赴宴，只留下四名外门弟子轮流看守山谷正门，所有人的注意力全都放在前门陷阱区域，后山全程无人看管。
陆衍借着树木掩护，缓步靠近灵泉核心泉眼，蹲在泉边仔细观摩灵泉自带的天然护阵。
陆家祖传灵泉搭配上古天然阵法，依靠天地昼夜灵气流转维持平衡，苏辰不懂阵法奥妙，只知道粗暴破开表层禁制，无休止抽取灵液。
他只顾自身修炼，肆意破坏阵法脉络，海量灵气没被吸收，白白飘散消散在空气里，大半灵泉资源全都白白浪费。
陆衍指尖轻点地面，顺着阵法纹路一点点梳理脉络，越看越是心惊。
苏辰持续粗暴汲取用不了三日，整套天然护阵就会彻底崩碎，灵泉直接枯竭报废，到时候陆家祖传根基彻底化为泡影，苏辰反倒能借着“灵泉自然报废，自己无力回天”的说辞，把所有锅甩给陆家祖上根基不行，继续保全自身大义人设。
除此之外，陆衍还留意到留守在灵泉角落的几名陆家老下人，这几人世代看管灵泉，如今被苏辰的手下肆意克扣月钱，每日干最重的活，连基础修炼丹药都被克扣一空，稍有怨言就会被跟班放出灵气威压恐吓，几人敢怒不敢言，只能默默埋头干活，满心委屈无处诉说。
陆衍躲在暗处不动声色，没有立刻现身出面解围。现在贸然出面惊动看守弟子，消息第一时间传到苏辰耳朵，对方立刻折返回来设局埋伏，打乱自己收回灵泉的全盘计划。
他默默把几名下人的遭遇记在心里，暗暗打定主意，等灵泉顺利收回之后，第一时间整顿下人待遇，整治歪风，绝不让自家下人继续受欺压。
接下来的时间，陆衍耐心蹲守，一边继续完善破阵收灵的方案，一边掐算灵气真空的具体到来时间。按照被天道篡改后的窗口期，还有不到一个半时辰，灵泉阵法进入短暂休眠，泉眼灵气暂停外泄，正是修改灵泉归属的绝佳机会。
等待途中，谷口传来细碎脚步声，两名苏辰的跟班闲来无事，结伴在谷内闲逛，嘴里闲聊的内容恰好被陆衍尽收耳中。
“苏师兄说了，只要陆衍敢半夜闯灵谷，触发正门陷阱，立马带人赶回，当着闻讯赶来的长老面卖惨，到时候陆蓄意抢夺机缘的罪名坐实，直接被宗门惩处，咱们跟着沾光领赏赐。”“可惜那纨绔往日虽然冲动，但这几天格外安分，迟迟不上套，真要是一直躲在院里，咱们埋伏岂不是白忙活？”
两人唠唠叨叨绕着泉边走了一圈，没留意后山树冠里的陆，逛完便返回正门继续值守。
陆衍听完暗自冷笑，苏辰挖空心思等着自己重蹈原主覆辙，却万万想不到自己压根不走正门，早已摸到破局关键。
又过片刻，天边夜色彻底浓郁，山谷里的灵气浓度肉眼可见开始快速下降，灵泉真空窗口期如期到来，阵法休眠，泉眼的护阵纹路尽数黯淡无光，整套天然禁制进入最脆弱的状态。
陆衍不再犹豫，准备落地动手，凭借对阵法的理解温和改动归属权，全程不动武、不伤人，只依靠阵法规则拿回祖产。
可就在他刚要动身的瞬间，系统突然弹出一条红色紧急提示：
【警报！苏辰提前结束宴席，正在全速折返灵泉，半个时辰之内就能抵达山谷，对方疑似察觉到灵气异动，准备临场抓包，陆衍的收泉操作将被当场撞破！】
content_en:
The system's urgent warning sounded in his mind, and Lu Yan stood up suddenly, his heart tightening.
The vacuum window period of Lingquan's spiritual energy that was originally scheduled for late at night was forcibly advanced by several hours by the law of heaven. The time left for him to act was suddenly compressed. If he missed this time, he would have to wait for another seven days. After seven days, Su Chen relied on the massive spiritual energy of Lingquan to improve by leaps and bounds. With stacked luck, he failed to trigger the mandatory task. The end result was that his Dantian was shattered and he died on the spot.
Fatty Zhao on the side was startled by Lu Yan's sudden action. He scratched his chubby face and asked in confusion: "What's wrong with the young master? What happened? Could it be that Su Chen's plan to visit tomorrow has changed?"
Lu Yan shook his head. He didn't have time to explain to Fatty the trick of Tiandao secretly changing the rules. He quickly warned: "Little Fatty, please stay in the house and keep an eye on the Lu family gate for me. If Su Chen sends someone to inquire about his whereabouts in advance, send a message as soon as possible. Uncle Zhou will continue to stay in the warehouse to take care of the elixirs to prevent the other party from secretly inquiring about resources in advance."
After arranging the tasks for the two of them, Lu Yan quickly changed into a dark tight night suit, with only a short dagger for opening roads tied around his waist, without any entourage. Leading people to infiltrate can easily be exploited by the law of heaven and be accused of gathering a crowd to provoke. Only acting alone is in line with the bottom line of conscience and can maximize the triggering of system conscience rewards.
Before going out, Lu Yan called up the system task panel and looked at it again:
[Main line mandatory mission: Recapture the Lu family’s ancestral innate spirit within three days, remaining time limit: the last day]
[The mission is successful: the conscience critical strike rating is randomly distributed with cultivation, skills, and luck; the mission is failed: the Dantian is shattered, the cultivation is cleared, and is immediately erased]
Now the public opinion of the entire sect has been tampered with by heaven. From the sect elders to ordinary outer disciples, everyone believes that the return of the spiritual spring to Su Chen is destiny. The Lu family wants to take back the spiritual spring.
Abandoning the stupid method of the original owner to rush in without any thought, Lu Yan bypassed the main road of the sect and chose the remote mountain and forest roads. The remaining bad luck of the Heavenly Way is still causing trouble in the dark. The thorns on the roadside grow inexplicably and wrap around the trouser legs. The dead branches above the head fall without wind. From time to time, gravel rolls down the mountain wall. Everywhere is a small obstacle deliberately created by the Heavenly Way.
Fortunately, the merit accumulated from previous good deeds continued to offset the negative effects, and most of the accidents were easily resolved. Lu Yan stumbled all the way, avoiding the trap-filled main entrance of Linggu, and sneaked towards the cliff in the back mountain that he had explored before.
Half an hour later, Lu Yan arrived at the bottom of the back mountain cliff. The cliff in front of him was steep, with jagged rocks, and climbing vines growing sporadically on the rock wall. It was no wonder that Su Chen didn't set a trap here at all. In his eyes, it was impossible for ordinary people to successfully climb to the top of this dangerous place.
Lu Yan's cultivation at the third level of Qi Refining, his physical body has been slightly tempered several times, far surpassing that of monks at the same level. He climbed up steadily by holding on to the thick vines, and successfully climbed to the inside of the back mountain of Linggu in half an hour.
Hiding in the canopy of dense and towering ancient trees, Lu quietly overlooked the entire Lingquan Valley. At this moment, the sky was dark, white mist was lingering above the eye of the spiritual spring, and a steady stream of pure spiritual energy was flowing in all directions. Su Chen was not in the valley. After the daytime retreat, he took several close disciples down the mountain to attend the banquet. Only four outer disciples were left to take turns guarding the main entrance of the valley. Everyone's attention was focused on the trap area at the front door, and the back mountain was unattended the entire time.
Lu Yan took advantage of the cover of trees and slowly approached the core spring of Lingquan. He squatted by the spring and carefully observed the natural protective formation of Lingquan.
The ancestral spiritual spring of the Lu family is combined with the ancient natural formation, which relies on the circulation of spiritual energy between heaven and earth day and night to maintain balance. Su Chen does not understand the secrets of the formation, he only knows how to roughly break through the surface restrictions and continuously extract the spiritual liquid.
He only focused on his own cultivation and wantonly destroyed the formation's veins. A large amount of spiritual energy was not absorbed and was scattered in the air. Most of the spiritual spring resources were wasted.
Lu Yan tapped his fingertips on the ground and followed the formation lines little by little to sort out the veins. The more he looked at it, the more frightened he became.
If Su Chen continued to absorb it roughly for less than three days, the entire natural protective formation would completely collapse, and the spiritual spring would be exhausted and scrapped. At that time, the ancestral foundation of the Lu family would be completely wiped out. Su Chen could instead use the rhetoric of "the spiritual spring will naturally be destroyed and there is nothing he can do to save it" to blame all the blame on the Lu family's ancestral foundation and continue to preserve his righteous character.
In addition, Lu Yan also noticed several old servants of the Lu family staying in the corner of Lingquan. These people have been taking care of Lingquan for generations. Now, Su Chen's men wantonly deducted their monthly payment. They do the heaviest work every day. Even the basic cultivation elixirs are deducted. If they complain at all, they will be threatened by the spiritual energy released by the servants. A few dare to be angry and dare not speak out. They can only work silently, full of grievances and nowhere to complain.
Lu Yan hid in the dark and remained calm, and did not show up immediately to come to the rescue. Now he rashly came forward to alarm the guarding disciples. The news reached Su Chen's ears immediately, and the other party immediately turned back and set up an ambush, disrupting his overall plan to recover the spiritual spring.
He silently kept the experiences of several servants in mind, and secretly made up his mind that after the spiritual spring was successfully recovered, he would immediately rectify the treatment of his servants, correct unhealthy practices, and never let his servants continue to be oppressed.
For the next time, Lu Yan stayed patiently, while continuing to perfect the plan to break the formation and collect the spirits, while calculating the specific time when the spiritual energy vacuum would arrive. According to the window period after being tampered with by Tiandao, there is less than an hour and a half left. The spirit spring formation enters a short dormancy, and the spiritual energy of the spring stops leaking. This is an excellent opportunity to modify the ownership of the spirit spring.
While waiting, the sound of soft footsteps came from the entrance of the valley. Two of Su Chen's followers had nothing to do, wandering together in the valley, and Lu Yan happened to catch all the chatter in their mouths.
"Senior Brother Su said that as long as Lu Yan dares to break into Linggu in the middle of the night, trigger the trap at the main entrance, lead people back immediately, and suffer miserably in front of the elders who came after hearing the news, then Lu Yan will be found guilty of deliberately snatching the opportunity, and he will be directly punished by the sect. We will receive the reward after being punished. "It's a pity that although the dude was impulsive in the past, he has been very calm these days and has been slow to fall into trap. If he had been hiding in the courtyard, wouldn't our work in ambush have been in vain?"
The two chattered and walked around the spring without paying attention to Lu in the canopy of the back mountain. After walking around, they returned to the main entrance to continue guarding.
After hearing this, Lu Yan sneered secretly. Su Chen worked hard to wait for him to make the same mistake as the original owner, but he never expected that he would have found the key to breaking the situation without taking the main entrance at all.
After a while, the night sky was completely dark, and the spiritual energy concentration in the valley began to decline rapidly with the naked eye. The vacuum window period of the spiritual spring arrived as scheduled, the formation went dormant, the protective formation lines of the spring were all dim, and the entire set of natural restrictions entered the most fragile state.
Lu Yan no longer hesitated and was ready to take action. He relied on his understanding of the formation to gently change the ownership rights. He did not use force or hurt anyone in the whole process, and only relied on the rules of the formation to get back his ancestral property.
But just when he was about to leave, the system suddenly popped up a red emergency prompt:
【Alert! Su Chen ended the banquet early and was returning to the spiritual spring at full speed. He could reach the valley in half an hour. The other party seemed to have noticed the abnormal movement of the spiritual energy and was preparing to capture him on the spot. Lu Yan's operation to collect the spring would be broken on the spot! 】

title_en: Chapter 5 The first compulsory mission to regain the opportunity to regain the spiritual spring Chapter 6 The forbearing layout and wait for the flaw in the destiny
